title: Thermal Water Reservoirs, District Heating and Enhanced Geothermal Systems (EGS)

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Because of the thin crust beneath the Pannonian Basin, its geothermal gradient is well above the European average (commonly cited as roughly 45 °C per kilometre against about 30 °C). The city of Szeged runs a large geothermal district heating system that replaces part of the natural gas used for heating.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Technical texts use past participles (*kitermelt*, *lehűlt*; you know them from B1 Unit 2) and verbal nouns in *-ás/-és* (from B1 Unit 16): `A kitermelt és lehűlt termálvíz visszasajtolása a vízadó rétegbe segít fenntartani a rezervoár nyomását és hőmérsékletét`.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A Pannon-medence geotermikus adottságai európai viszonylatban kedvezőek.
The geothermal endowment of the Pannonian Basin is favourable by European standards.
Szegeden a geotermikus távfűtés a földgáz egy részét váltotta ki.
In Szeged geothermal district heating has replaced part of the natural gas.
A visszasajtolás elengedhetetlen a hévízkészletek kimerülésének megelőzésére.
Reinjection is essential to prevent depletion of thermal water reserves.
